sentence: This project uses computer vision to take measurements of movement from video of signers and compares patterns between different groups of signers.
This project builds standards and tools that help people find geoscience data and judge whether it fits their use.
This project studies how a transcription factor builds the epigenome that a plant uses to respond to a defense hormone.
This project tries to help scientists in ecology, evolution and marine science work together on emerging infectious disease.
This project turns old smartphones into sensors that run without batteries so they can monitor trees and rivers.
This project studies how a 3D environment changes the extracellular vesicles that mesenchymal stromal cells make.
This project supports research in many parts of ocean science, including ocean circulation, robotics and ocean modeling.
This project builds learning methods that stay safe by avoiding dangerous actions, and tests them in simulations and with unmanned aerial vehicles.
This project tests whether a tiny printer built on a chip can print solid patterns from extremely small droplets.
This project studies the mathematics of how machines such as robots and cars move and how to control them.
This project tries to find out how yeast cells control a DNA repair process that fixes damage in genes being read.
This project studies how quantum and classical computers can work together to solve hard optimization problems in chemical engineering.
This project uses machine learning to build equations that predict how materials behave and say how uncertain each prediction is.
This project tests whether placing molecules inside tiny optical cavities can change how fast energy moves and so change the outcome of chemical reactions.
This project studies how fire works in the sagebrush ecosystem, including fuel buildup, soil water and smoke, using computer models and aerial robots.
This project builds models for turbulent premixed flames that describe energy backscatter, using data from detailed computer simulations.
This project studies bee parasites and viruses, including how some honey bees resist a mite and how disease spreads between domestic and wild bees.
This project gets a long-read sequencer to study genome structure and function, plant-microbe interactions and plant sex chromosome evolution.
This project measures tiny gravitational distortions that dwarf galaxies cause in images of distant galaxies to map the dark matter around them.
